subject: ICT
title: Let's Find Out
subtitle: Spot the differences
hero_picture: A kitten and a girl looking at a framed photo on the wall showing two kittens that look almost the same.

sections.heading: Which one is me?
text: Kuttan the cat sees a photo of two kittens.
'Which one is me in the photo?' he wonders.
They look the same. Look closely!
sections.caption: Which kitten is me?
sections.picture: A framed photo of two almost identical kittens side by side, a real kitten looking at it curiously.

sections.heading: Two pictures
text: Here are two pictures of a tree.
They look the same, but not fully.
In one picture, a bird is missing!
sections.caption: Two tree pictures
sections.picture: Two nearly identical pictures side by side of a curly tree with birds on its branches; in the right picture one bird is missing.

sections.heading: Look part by part
text: Look at the top, then the middle, then the bottom.
Check the birds, the flowers, the grass.
sections.caption: Pointing at a difference
sections.picture: A child's finger pointing at a small difference between two pictures of a garden, one picture has an extra flower.

sections.heading: Photo hunter game
text: Two pictures are shown side by side.
Click wherever there is a difference.
sections.caption: Photo hunter on screen
sections.picture: A laptop screen showing two nearly identical tree pictures side by side, with a small circle drawn around one difference.

sections.heading: Find out around you
text: Look at your friend's drawing and yours.
What is the same? What is different?
Observing well is a good habit.
sections.caption: Comparing drawings
sections.picture: Two children comparing two drawings of a house on paper, one with a chimney and one without.

rhyme: A little bird has gone to hide,
Look up, look down, look all around,
activity: Draw two faces. Make one small change in the second face. Ask a friend to find it.
talk: What was missing in the second tree picture?
How do we look for differences?
summary: We can look carefully, part by part, to find differences between two pictures.

questions.prompt: In 'Photo hunter', where do we click?
questions.explanation: Click wherever the pictures are different.

questions.prompt: What was missing in one tree picture?
How should we look for differences?
Two things that look the same and have no change are...
questions.explanation: With no change, they are the same.

questions.prompt: Who looked at the photo of two kittens?
questions.explanation: Kuttan the cat looked at it.
